title: Astra gave me GTA VI in one shot!
author: wannabestraight
selftext:
So i was messing around in my game engine (made to be natively used by AI) and wanted to see what gpt-6 astra could pull off inside it, asked to make GTA VI for the playstation 1 and tbh, was surprised AF when it just dumped a 1:1 shot remake of the original trailer as intro for the game..

If you are interested, there is also actual gameplay and it's  \\\[playable here\\\](https://origozero.ai/world/Deata/gta-vi-psx) you can also fully inspect the code and even fork it if you want to mess around with and see how it's made or make your own modded version.

For anyone curious about how, everything was made in luau including the cutscenes etc, you can play the trailer yourself from the menu.

(Platform can have bugs, don't rip me a new one 😭)

comments.author: dMONKEYMANb
comments.body: 14 year old me would have said " Wow! This looks so realistic !"
